For the clash with Latvia, Vucinic has no fresh injury concerns, so he could go with an unchanged XI.

As for Latvia, their goal has already turned to trying to stay in League C after a disappointing start to their campaign. [...] On Friday, Nicolato is expected to pack the defence and make life as difficult as possible for Montenegro.
